Passport Size Photo Maker

This passport size photo maker online tool crops your picture to the official 35 × 45 mm ratio and exports it at 413 × 531 pixels (300 DPI) — the size used for Pakistani passports, CNIC-related forms and most visa applications. It can also remove the background of your photo and replace it with plain white or blue, and make a 4-copy print sheet for the studio.

🔒 Your files never leave your device.

📸 For the best result, choose a clear, front-facing photo in good light. The tool uses a photo-grade AI model to remove the background — even a busy background — and replace it with white or blue (pick below), keeping hair edges clean. The first time you use it, the AI model downloads once (about 90 MB, so use Wi-Fi if you can); after that it stays cached, runs right on your device, and your photo is never uploaded. Tip: take earphones and loose wires off before the photo — thin wires can confuse the AI.

How to use

  1. Choose a clear front-facing photo — a plain wall behind you gives the cleanest background removal.
  2. Adjust the zoom slider so your face fills the frame the way you want, and pick White, Blue or Keep original as the background.
  3. Press Make passport photo and download the 413 × 531 px JPG. For the studio, also make the print sheet — 4 copies on one 4 × 6 inch page.

How it works

Passport photos are 35 mm wide and 45 mm high. At print quality (300 DPI) that is 413 × 531 pixels. The tool centre-crops your picture to the 35:45 ratio — keeping the face area — and places it on a white background at exactly that size.

Worked example: Example: a normal selfie cropped with zoom 1.4 usually frames the head and shoulders correctly for a 35 × 45 mm print.

Frequently asked questions

What is the passport photo size in Pakistan?

35 × 45 mm, which is 413 × 531 pixels at 300 DPI. This is the size this tool produces.

Can I use this photo for online forms?

Yes — the JPG is sized for both printing and uploading. If a form also has a KB limit, run the result through our Image Compressor to KB tool.

What background should a passport photo have?

A plain white background is the standard requirement (some forms ask for blue). This tool removes your photo's background with a photo-grade AI matting model — it works on busy backgrounds too, not just plain walls, and keeps hair edges clean — and replaces it with white or blue. The AI model downloads once (about 90 MB) and then runs entirely on your device; your photo is never uploaded.

Is my photo uploaded anywhere?

No. The crop is made in your browser; your files never leave your device.
